world.story:
Little Red Riding Hood skipped along the woodland path, carrying a basket of cake and a corked bottle for Grandmother.

A charcoal-gray wolf stepped from the ferns. “Where are you going?” he asked sweetly.

Red pointed toward the cottage. “Grandmother isn’t feeling well.”

“Then take her some flowers,” suggested the wolf. While Red wandered among the blossoms, he hurried away.

At the cottage, he imitated Red’s voice. Grandmother opened the door. Before she could escape, he swallowed her whole! Then he pulled on her white nightcap and climbed into bed.

Red arrived and set her basket on the table. She approached the bed, clutching her cape.

“Grandmother, what big ears you have!”

“All the better to hear you with.”

“What big eyes you have!”

“All the better to see you with.”

Red backed away, trembling. “What big teeth you have!”

“All the better to eat you with!”

The wolf leaped from bed and swallowed her. With his belly round, he lay down and snored.

A passing huntsman heard the dreadful noise. Inside, he spotted the nightcap and understood. Taking sewing scissors from the shelf, he carefully snipped open the sleeping wolf’s belly.

Red scrambled out, gasping, followed by Grandmother. They clung together, shaking with relief.

Red fetched six heavy stones from outside. The huntsman placed them inside the wolf and stitched him closed with a threaded needle.

The wolf woke and tried to flee, but the stones dragged him down. He fell dead beside the bed.

Red hugged Grandmother tightly. Together they shared the cake with their rescuer, and Red promised never to stray from the path again.

red.name: Little Red Riding Hood
red.look: Small girl with rosy cheeks and a dark brown bob, wearing a bright red hooded cape, cream blouse, blue skirt, white stockings, and brown buckle shoes.
red.height: A small child, about half the height of a grown person.
red.spec: A small, slight girl with a round face, rosy cheeks, brown eyes, and a straight dark brown bob ending at her chin. She wears a bright crimson hooded cape fastened at the throat, a cream long-sleeved blouse, a knee-length muted blue skirt, white stockings, and brown shoes with small brass buckles. The cape reaches just below her skirt, and its roomy hood frames her face while leaving the ends of her bob visible.

chk.misses: The cape is a muted coral-red rather than bright crimson.

The cape is muted coral-red rather than bright crimson, and its hem is roughly level with the skirt rather than just below it. The skirt falls below the knees, and the footwear is ankle boots rather than shoes.

The cape is muted salmon rather than bright crimson and ends at the waist instead of just below the skirt. The hood is down rather than framing her face. The skirt extends below the knees, and she wears brown ankle boots without brass buckles instead of buckled shoes.

wolf.name: The Wolf
wolf.look: Large charcoal-gray wolf, taller than Red when upright, with a cream muzzle, pointed ears, bushy tail, yellow eyes, and a wide, toothy mouth; his belly becomes round after swallowing his victims.
wolf.height: An upright wolf, about a head taller than the huntsman and much taller than Red.
wolf.spec: A large anthropomorphic charcoal-gray wolf who stands and moves upright like a person, with long limbs, furry paws, pointed ears, and a thick bushy tail. He has a cream muzzle, a black nose, yellow eyes, and a wide mouth full of large pointed white teeth. He wears no clothing except Grandmother’s oversized white nightcap with its ruffled edge and pale blue ribbon when disguised as her. His normally lean belly swells after swallowing Grandmother, becomes conspicuously round after swallowing Red as well, and remains round when the six stones replace them.

chk.misses: The wolf appears four times in different views and story states rather than once. Insets include colored backdrops, a bed, bedding, and a window with trees; the right-hand view includes stones, grass, and a ground plane. Two views depict the later swollen-belly state.

Conspicuously swollen belly depicts a later story state rather than his normally lean build. Fur is greenish-gray rather than charcoal-gray. His mouth is closed, so the large pointed white teeth are not shown.

grandmother.name: Grandmother
grandmother.look: Petite elderly woman with a silver braid, kind brown eyes, a long cream nightdress, and brown slippers.
grandmother.height: A petite elderly grown woman, about one and a half times Red’s height and noticeably shorter than the huntsman.
grandmother.spec: A petite, slender elderly woman with a gently stooped posture, a softly wrinkled face, kind brown eyes, and silver hair gathered into one thin braid down her back. She wears a loose, long-sleeved cream nightdress reaching her ankles and plain brown slippers. Her usual sleeping cap is the separate oversized white cotton nightcap with a ruffled edge and pale blue ribbon; her braid remains visible beneath it when she wears it.

huntsman.name: The Huntsman
huntsman.look: Broad-shouldered man with a chestnut beard, green felt hat, moss-green coat, tan trousers, and sturdy black boots.
huntsman.height: A tall grown man, about twice Red’s height.
huntsman.spec: A broad-shouldered, sturdy man with a square face, brown eyes, short chestnut hair, and a full chestnut beard and mustache. He wears a green felt hat with a low crown and modest brim, a thigh-length moss-green coat with brown buttons, tan trousers, and sturdy black boots reaching halfway up his calves. His coat is worn over a plain cream shirt, with no weapons or additional equipment attached to his clothing.

basket.name: Red’s Basket
basket.look: Small honey-colored wicker basket with one curved handle and a red-checkered cloth covering a golden cake and a short corked bottle.
basket.height: Fits across Red’s two hands; the handle can be carried in one of her hands.
basket.spec: A small oval honey-colored wicker basket, approximately 20 centimeters across, with a flat base and one fixed curved handle arching over its center. A cream-and-crimson checked cloth covers a small round golden cake and a short muted-green glass bottle sealed with a natural brown cork. The cloth has loose corners that hang slightly over the basket’s rim, and the bottle is short enough to fit beneath the handle.

chk.misses: The checked cloth is pulled aside, leaving the cake and bottle exposed rather than covering them.

nightcap.name: Grandmother’s Nightcap
nightcap.look: Oversized white cotton sleeping cap with a ruffled edge and pale blue ribbon.
nightcap.height: A soft adult-sized cap that fits in two cupped hands, roomy enough for Grandmother or the wolf.
nightcap.spec: An oversized white cotton sleeping cap with a soft, gathered crown and a broad ruffled edge. A pale blue ribbon runs around the gathered edge and ties in a small bow beneath the wearer’s chin. Its generous crown accommodates the wolf’s head, while his pointed ears remain visible outside the cap’s sides.

chk.misses: The cap has two pointed, pink-lined ears built into its sides. The prop should not include ears; the wolf’s own ears would remain visible outside it when worn.

scissors.name: Sewing Scissors
scissors.look: Large silver sewing scissors with rounded brass finger loops.
scissors.height: Slightly longer than a grown person’s hand; operated with one adult hand.
scissors.spec: A large pair of sewing scissors approximately 23 centimeters long, with straight silver blades, tapered tips, and a visible round pivot screw. The handles have two rounded brass finger loops, one slightly larger than the other. The silver blades and brass loops remain distinct, with no painted grips or decorative markings.

needle.name: Threaded Needle
needle.look: Slender silver sewing needle threaded with a long strand of dark blue thread.
needle.height: The needle fits between two fingertips; its thread extends several adult hand-lengths.
needle.spec: A slender straight silver sewing needle approximately 4 centimeters long, with one sharp point and a small oval eye at the opposite end. A single long strand of dark blue thread passes through the eye, with one short tail and one much longer working length.

chk.misses: The thread’s working length is too short relative to the needle to extend several adult hand-lengths.

stones.name: Heavy Stones
stones.look: A compact cluster of six smooth gray stones, each roughly the size of Red’s fist.
stones.height: Each stone is roughly the size of Red’s fist; all six together make a cluster that fits in two cupped adult hands.
stones.spec: A compact group of exactly six solid gray stones, each roughly the size of Red’s closed fist. Every stone is smoothly rounded and slightly irregular rather than perfectly spherical, with subtle variations from medium gray to slate gray. They have no sharp edges, markings, or attached material.

chk.misses: The six stones have prominent red, yellow, beige, and olive patches rather than solid medium-to-slate gray. Several have angular contours and crack-like markings instead of smooth, unmarked surfaces. A tan ground wash and shadows appear beneath the group.
